strings.name: Liang Wenfeng
strings.summary: Liang Wenfeng co-founded High-Flyer and founded DeepSeek in 2023, extending computing and machine-learning experience from quantitative investing into large-model research. He contributes to team research. DeepSeek’s open-weight models and training efficiency attracted international attention; the team’s work is not solely his achievement.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026. Model releases, paper submissions and company API updates are distinguished. Costs retain the technical report’s limited scope; research goals are separate from achieved capabilities.
strings.influence.rationale: Founded DeepSeek and contributed to AI model research, advancing discussion of open models, training efficiency and global technology competition.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: Studied electronic information engineering at Zhejiang University; earned a master’s in information and communication engineering in 2010.
strings.facts.f2.label: Research training
strings.facts.f2.value: Studied machine vision under Xiang Zhiyu during graduate school.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Open models and team research
strings.highlights.h1.text: DeepSeek released R1 weights and code for research and commercial use; distilled models also require attention to their base-model licenses.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Boundaries of training-cost estimates
strings.highlights.h2.text: The V3 report estimates about US$5.576 million for official training compute, excluding prior research and ablation experiments; this is not total company R&D spending.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Company expands application APIs
strings.timeline.t1.text: DeepSeek announces developer access to search, file input, URL reading, voice and other application API capabilities.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Long-term research priorities reported
strings.timeline.t2.text: Reuters cites Yicai’s account of a recent investor meeting: he prioritises long-term AGI research and favours keeping advanced models open.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Team releases DeepSeek-R1
strings.timeline.t3.text: Releases a reasoning model and smaller distilled models. The approach includes reinforcement learning; R1 does not entirely dispense with supervised fine-tuning.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Team releases DeepSeek-V3
strings.timeline.t4.text: The official API upgrades to V3; the subsequently submitted technical report lists Liang among many coauthors.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Founds DeepSeek
strings.timeline.t5.text: Establishes an AI research company, initially funded partly from High-Flyer proceeds.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Co-founds High-Flyer
strings.timeline.t6.text: With college classmates, establishes a quantitative investment firm using mathematics and AI to study trading.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Earns master’s degree
strings.timeline.t7.text: Completes graduate study in information and communication engineering at Zhejiang University.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Enters Zhejiang University
strings.timeline.t8.text: Begins studying electronic information engineering and later continues graduate study at the same university.
